context: Reference implementation: lazy fallback with computeIfAbsent and requireNonNullElseGet.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates StationResolver.java with both methods, the nested record, interface, and static factory, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves resolve and pricing contracts
checklist.description: resolve returns the cached value when present and stores fetched stations; pricingFor returns configured when non-null and the standard pricing otherwise.

checklist.name: Fetches only on a cache miss
checklist.description: The directory fetch happens inside cache.computeIfAbsent(stationId, id -> directory.fetch(id)) or inside a branch that runs only when the cache has no entry; it is never called before the cache check.

checklist.name: Builds standard pricing lazily
checklist.description: Pricing.standardFor is invoked only when configured is null, for example via Objects.requireNonNullElseGet(configured, () -> Pricing.standardFor(station)) or a plain branch; not via requireNonNullElse, Optional.orElse, or a precomputed local.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, synchronization redesign, extra public API, or dependency changes.

metadata.reference_selection: Candidate for main promotion; classify from the isolated hosted run.
